Subject: Invitation to Speak at [Conference Name]

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of [Organization/Conference Name] to invite you to be a keynote speaker at our upcoming conference, [Conference Name], taking place on [Date] in [Location].

The theme of this year’s conference is [Theme], focusing on [brief description of theme]. Given your extensive expertise and thought leadership in [Speaker's Field/Topic], we believe you would be an exceptional fit to inspire our audience. Your recent work on [Specific Work/Topic] particularly resonates with the direction we hope to take this year.

We would be honored to have you deliver a [Duration, e.g., 45-minute] keynote address. In terms of engagement, we are pleased to offer a speaking fee of [Amount], along with coverage of all travel and accommodation expenses.

Please let us know if you are available and interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to discuss further details at your convenience.

Thank you for considering our invitation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Organization Name]
[Contact Information]
